_about: Edit this, not mods/duelists.lua. scripts/er-duelist-gear.py dresses the duelists from `build` (a planner ?b= link or id) and writes mods/duelists.lua; scripts/er-ai-lab.py runs it at start and before every respawn. `think` is the NpcThinkParam row the duelists' bodies are spawned with (Moonrithyll's), `brains` the mods/brain_<name>.lua each think row runs ({row: name}; a single `brain` names the brain of `think` itself), and `summons` how many get gear keys, think.0 .. think.N-1. `mods` is everything the AI agent runs in a duelist lab (er-ai-lab.py --duelists): the brain and the gear, nothing else, so no other mod drives them. `agents` are Frida agents the lab loads beside them ({name: {path under scripts/frida, config}}): block-trainer.js drives the defender's guard, sprint and stick against the attacker on team `attackerTeam` (the player when absent). `respawn` is the spawn-npc.js config: Moonrithyll's NpcParam, think and CharaInitParam rows, one `at` spot per duelist on the geom-lab arena's two start markers, each on its own Colosseum team (72 and 73), fight false so they spawn held until fight(true) or the in-game lever releases them, and shell true so spawn-npc.js gives them nothing the build does not (no flasks, no food, no Ash of War swaps). Spot 0 is the defender: it is spawned on think row 524030000 (Moonrithyll's logic 10000 and battle goal 29999 under another id), so brain_block.lua runs it alone, and the trainer drives it. Spot 1 is the attacker on Moonrithyll's own row, running brain_attack.lua: it runs at the defender and swings R1 or R2, with no jump, Ash of War, weapon swap or roll. Both have `fight: true`, so neither is held (a held character takes no input, the trainer's included). For the player as the attacker instead, give spot 0 `vs: player` and drop `attackerTeam`.
